cards.example_en: The police will investigate the accident.
Join the art club if you enjoy painting.
cards.example_zh: 如果你喜欢画画，就加入美术社团吧。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：保持；继续

cards.example_en: Late frost can kill young plants in the garden.
cards.example_zh: 晚霜会把花园里的幼苗冻死。

cards.example_en: I know a safe path to the nearest bus stop.
cards.example_zh: 我知道一条通往最近公交站的安全小路。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：发射；发起
cards.example_en: The reading club will launch a book week in March.
cards.example_zh: 阅读社团将在三月发起读书周。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：放置；下蛋
cards.example_en: Lay the map flat on the desk so everyone can see it.
cards.example_zh: 把地图平铺在书桌上，好让每个人都能看见。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：让；允许
cards.example_en: Let me help you with that box.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：躺；说谎
cards.example_en: Lie on the sofa for a while if you feel dizzy.
cards.example_zh: 如果觉得头晕，就在沙发上躺一会儿。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：听；倾听
cards.example_en: Listen carefully to the announcement in the hall.
cards.example_zh: 仔细听礼堂里的广播通知。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：生活；居住
cards.example_en: My cousins live in a flat near the city park.
cards.example_zh: 我的表兄妹住在城市公园附近的一套公寓里。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：位于；找出
cards.example_en: Can you locate your seat on the map?
cards.example_zh: 你能在地图上找到你的座位吗？

cards.example_en: It is hard to maintain a healthy diet.
Grandma and I make dumplings every Spring Festival.
cards.example_zh: 每年春节，我和奶奶一起包饺子。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：设法；管理
cards.example_en: She can manage the weekend book sale by herself.
cards.example_zh: 周末的售书活动她一个人就能办好。
